name: Index-rebalance post-auction reversal
hypothesis: On the following eligible session, enter only after price reverses the prior auction residual with normal liquidity.
spec: Setup: Mechanical closing demand may temporarily move price beyond the next-session reference. Entry: On the following eligible session, enter only after price reverses the prior auction residual with normal liquidity. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit at residual convergence or same-day risk/time limit. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs primary filings / corporate-event data with receipt times (licensed feed)
